paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: This figure compares the error rate (one average minus test accuracy), computation cost, and GPU memory across our approach and baselines, for fine-tuning Llama-3-8B on ten NLP tasks with QAdapter.
model_annotation: The provided bar chart, titled “QAdapter,” visually represents the GPU memory consumption in gigabytes (GB) for various methods used in fine-tuning the Llama-3-8B model with QAdapter, as indicated by the vertical axis labeled “GPU Memory (GB)” which uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60 with tick marks at intervals of 20. The horizontal axis displays the method names — “Full FT,” “MTL-FT,” “TAG,” “Adapter,” “QAdapter,” and “Ours” — arranged in left-to-right order without explicit sorting. Each method is represented by a single vertical bar: “Full FT” is shown as a tall orange bar reaching approximately 70 GB; “MTL-FT” is an orange bar at approximately 42 GB; “TAG” is an orange bar at approximately 20 GB; “Adapter” is an orange bar at approximately 18 GB; “QAdapter” is a short orange bar at approximately 8 GB; and “Ours” is a green bar at approximately 20 GB. All bars are uniformly colored except for “Ours,” which is green, and they are not visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or annotations beyond their color distinction.
